description:
## What's new

- **Share songs, albums, playlists and artists.** Every share button now opens a sheet with a Spotify-style story picture — cover art on a background pulled from the artwork itself, title, artist, a QR code, and your link `lunara.ankitak.com.np`. Send the picture to Instagram Stories or WhatsApp, or just copy the link.
- **Links open in Lunara.** Shared links open straight in the app when it is installed, and land on the new lunara.ankitak.com.np site — with a Get-it-on-GitHub page — when it is not.
